description: Ranks current RunPod GPU offers by price and freshness for a given workload. Billed per successful match — the real price is in the response's billing.price_usd field; never assume a fixed amount, it can change server-side. Auth: if a SCOUTWYZE_API_KEY env var is configured, calls with a prepaid Bearer key (billing.rail: "bearer" in the response — never charged on a no-match result). If unauthenticated, or the key is invalid, this tool returns a real HTTP 402 x402 payment challenge (nonce, payTo, maxAmountRequired, expiresAt) as its result content, not an error — this server holds no private key and cannot pay it. A wallet-capable calling agent must settle the challenge independently and retry with the resulting X-PAYMENT proof (billing.rail: "x402" on success — settles before scoring, no refund on a no-match result, see SOT.md §5).

gpuClass.description: Filter by GPU model substring, e.g. "H100" (case-insensitive)

maxPricePerHour.description: Maximum vendor hourly price in USD
